decisions.decision: Doug operates production; a named backup operator who passes a restore drill is a go-live gate
decisions.rejected: managed Moodle host (restricts plugins/CLI that local_ltuse and spec 001 need)

decisions.decision: Hetzner Cloud 4 vCPU/8 GB VPS, Ubuntu 24.04, Moodle from git on MOODLE_502_STABLE, PHP 8.3 + PostgreSQL 16
decisions.why: flat monthly price, hourly billing for drill servers; versions confirmed in our 5.2 environment.xml

decisions.decision: Nightly pg_dump + moodledata via restic to Backblaze B2, 30-day retention
decisions.rejected: Hetzner Storage Box (same provider), Moodle course backups (cannot restore a site)

decisions.decision: Restore drills on throwaway VPS with noemailever, verified on standing test accounts
decisions.why: keeps real learner data off the shared host and never messages learners

decisions.decision: UptimeRobot external check plus Healthchecks.io dead-man pings from check.sh and backup.sh
decisions.why: catches both outside outages and silent cron/backup failures on free tiers

decisions.decision: ltuse.net becomes the upgrade test instance; security releases within 14 days after a test publish
decisions.why: already exists and holds no real learner data

plan.summary: Plan for dedicated production VPS with scripted provision/backup/restore/check under moodle/ops/, runbook, and flat-cost operations register
plan.key_finding: tool_task cronrunning check and admin/cli/checks.php exist on our 5.2.3+ source, so cron monitoring needs no plugin

approach: Idempotent shell scripts and systemd units under moodle/ops/ provision a Hetzner VPS, back up nightly to B2 with restic, and feed free-tier monitors. A runbook and operations register name Doug as operator and gate go-live on a named backup operator passing a restore drill.
